# Jaime Yan — jaimeyan.com

> Personal site of Jaime Yan, Associate Director of Statistical Programming and
> clinical data science lead. Research focus: AI/LLM automation for clinical
> trial statistical programming, CDISC data standards (SDTM/ADaM), and
> deterministic, auditable agentic systems for GxP environments.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://jaimeyan.com/): bio, experience, publications, projects
- [Blog](https://jaimeyan.com/blog.html): field guides, research deep-dives, notes
- [Paper pages](https://jaimeyan.com/): per-publication pages under /papers/*.html
  with full abstracts and citation metadata
- [RSS feed](https://jaimeyan.com/rss.xml)

- [CDISC CORE Explained](https://jaimeyan.com/blog/cdisc-core-validation-explained.html)

- [LLM Agents in Clinical Trials](https://jaimeyan.com/blog/llm-agents-clinical-trials-reality.html)

## Research highlights

- [CAVE-Onc: graph-constrained validation for CDISC oncology data](https://jaimeyan.com/papers/cave-onc.html)
